scientific_integrity: All proof steps are stated directly and the finite checker is explicitly distinguished from an infinite proof. The associated earlier finite-model and infinite-separation results are credited, not reclaimed. The review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: A countable existence construction, not an infinite-frame classification. The result concerns same-carrier, same-valuation Kripke representations; representations on extensions of the world set are not excluded. Priority under older neighborhood-filter or saturation terminology remains a residual risk.
title: A variable-free countable obstruction to closure-model Kripke representation
